name: Busa CLM
description: Lightweight contract lifecycle desk: contract inventory, lifecycle stage, owners, obligations, renewal/notice dates, and a simple approval reminder queue. Not a legal redline/clause-review product -- see busa-legal-contracts for that. Contract records, obligation status, renewal acknowledgements, and approval decisions are all direct writes made by the operator in the browser, not a review/approval pipeline.

agentPrompts.label: Show me the contract lifecycle overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder, then summarize the lifecycle pipeline by stage, upcoming renewals, and at-risk obligations.

agentPrompts.label: What needs my attention today?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder, then summarize what needs attention: overdue obligations, upcoming renewal notice deadlines, and pending approval decisions.
